Data

data <- data.frame(
  periode = 1:20,
  market_share = c(
    3.63, 4.20, 3.33, 4.54, 2.89,
    4.87, 4.90, 5.29, 6.18, 7.20,
    7.25, 6.09, 6.80, 8.65, 8.43,
    8.29, 7.18, 7.90, 8.45, 8.23

  price = c(
    0.97, 0.95, 0.99, 0.91, 0.98,
    0.90, 0.89, 0.86, 0.85, 0.82,
    0.79, 0.83, 0.81, 0.77, 0.76,
    0.80, 0.83, 0.79, 0.76, 0.78
  )
)

Pemodelan Regresi Deret Waktu

model <- lm(price ~ periode, data = data)

summary(model)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = price ~ periode, data = data)
## 
## Residuals:
##       Min        1Q    Median        3Q       Max 
## -0.056248 -0.019632 -0.003015  0.014523  0.064729 
## 
## Coefficients:
##              Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)  0.972789   0.015911  61.141  < 2e-16 ***
## periode     -0.011504   0.001328  -8.661 7.77e-08 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.03425 on 18 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.8065, Adjusted R-squared:  0.7957 
## F-statistic: 75.02 on 1 and 18 DF,  p-value: 7.768e-08

Hasil Model

data$residual <- residuals(model)

data

Pemeriksaan Autokorelasi

Plot Residual

ggplot(data, aes(x = periode, y = residual)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Plot Residual terhadap Waktu",
    x = "Periode",
    y = "Residual"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

Durbin-Watson

dwtest(model)
## 
##  Durbin-Watson test
## 
## data:  model
## DW = 1.4133, p-value = 0.05075
## alternative hypothesis: true autocorrelation is greater than 0

ACF Residual

acf(
  data$residual,
  main = "ACF Residual"
)

Penanganan Autokorelasi

model_pw <- prais_winsten(
  price ~ periode,
  data = data,
  index = "periode"
)
## Iteration 0: rho = 0
## Iteration 1: rho = 0.2769
## Iteration 2: rho = 0.2798
## Iteration 3: rho = 0.2799
## Iteration 4: rho = 0.2799
## Iteration 5: rho = 0.2799
summary(model_pw)
## 
## Call:
## prais_winsten(formula = price ~ periode, data = data, index = "periode")
## 
## Residuals:
##       Min        1Q    Median        3Q       Max 
## -0.057190 -0.020208 -0.003227  0.012689  0.064761 
## 
## AR(1) coefficient rho after 5 iterations: 0.2799
## 
## Coefficients:
##              Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)  0.971947   0.020279  47.929  < 2e-16 ***
## periode     -0.011342   0.001678  -6.761 2.47e-06 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.03298 on 18 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.8743, Adjusted R-squared:  0.8673 
## F-statistic: 125.2 on 1 and 18 DF,  p-value: 1.54e-09
## 
## Durbin-Watson statistic (original): 1.413 
## Durbin-Watson statistic (transformed): 2.076

Pemeriksaan Setelah Penanganan

dwtest(model_pw)
## 
##  Durbin-Watson test
## 
## data:  model_pw
## DW = 1.4133, p-value = 0.05075
## alternative hypothesis: true autocorrelation is greater than 0
dwtest(model)
## 
##  Durbin-Watson test
## 
## data:  model
## DW = 1.4133, p-value = 0.05075
## alternative hypothesis: true autocorrelation is greater than 0
dwtest(model_pw)
## 
##  Durbin-Watson test
## 
## data:  model_pw
## DW = 1.4133, p-value = 0.05075
## alternative hypothesis: true autocorrelation is greater than 0

Kesimpulan

Model awalnya: \(Price_t\) = 0.97279−0.01150t

dan statistik Durbin-Watson sekitar: DW = 1.413

yang mengarah pada autokorelasi positif, sehingga perlu dilanjutkan dengan pemeriksaan signifikansi Durbin-Watson dan, jika signifikan, penanganan menggunakan model seperti Prais-Winsten.

Regresi

model_ms <- lm(
  market_share ~ periode,
  data = data
)

summary(model_ms)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = market_share ~ periode, data = data)
## 
## Residuals:
##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -1.72239 -0.51580 -0.08862  0.46442  1.41516 
## 
## Coefficients:
##             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)

## periode      0.29138    0.03063   9.514 1.91e-08 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.7898 on 18 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.8341, Adjusted R-squared:  0.8249 
## F-statistic: 90.52 on 1 and 18 DF,  p-value: 1.911e-08

  price ~ periode,
  data = data
)

summary(model_price)

## Call:

Residual

data$residual <- residuals(model)

Plot Residual

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data, aes(x = periode, y = residual)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Plot Residual terhadap Waktu",
    x = "Periode",
    y = "Residual"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

Durbin Watson

library(lmtest)

dwtest(model_ms)
## 
##  Durbin-Watson test
## 
## data:  model_ms
## DW = 1.5633, p-value = 0.1015
## alternative hypothesis: true autocorrelation is greater than 0
dwtest(model_price)
## 
##  Durbin-Watson test
## 
## data:  model_price
## DW = 1.4133, p-value = 0.05075
## alternative hypothesis: true autocorrelation is greater than 0

ACF Residual

acf(
  residuals(model_ms),
  main = "ACF Residual Market Share"
)

acf(
  residuals(model_price),
  main = "ACF Residual Price"
)

Kesimpulan

Karena: 0.05075 > 0.05 maka H₀ tidak ditolak.

Berdasarkan uji Durbin-Watson pada taraf nyata 5%, tidak terdapat bukti yang cukup untuk menyatakan adanya autokorelasi positif pada residual model.
